quotes.text:
/**
 * Perform compaction on the given folders.
 * Compaction means removing deleted messages from the msgStore and
 * updating the retained messages in the database with new storeTokens
 * (and sizes).
 *
 * - Progress/status updates will be communicated to the GUI window.
 * - When the operation completes, listener.onStopRunningUrl() will be called.
 * - listener.onStartRunningUrl() is never called.
 * - The operation is considered complete when all the folders have been
 *   compacted.
 * - It's safe to call this with an empty list of folders. The listener
 *   will still be called.
 * - The listener will _never_ be called before AsyncCompactFolders()
 *   returns.
 * - If AsyncCompactFolders() returns a failure code, no listener callbacks
 *   will be invoked.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Historical EwsFolder adds CompactAll and Compact overrides, and the fixed accepted successor is ExchangeFolder after verified source renames. CompactAll gets the account root descendants and a message store; Compact submits {this}. Both return AsyncCompactFolders. Keep the account-wide and single-folder boundaries explicit. The shared function retains its separate listener/return contract; no server-side EWS expunge or native compaction ran. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Exchange compaction delegates selected folders to the shared asynchronous compactor
